caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket that is oval in shape, placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The basket is constructed from coiled fiber arranged in horizontal rows, with a visibly textured surface showing the interwoven pattern of the strands. The colors of the basket range from light to medium brown, with occasional hints of darker and darker brown tones that emphasize the natural variations in the fiber material. The top rim is even and slightly rounded, and the sides curve gently outward before tapering back in toward the bottom. The light source comes from the upper left, casting a subtle, faint shadow underneath on the right side. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Hickory Bark and Oat Straw Basket
